subject: Charged twice this month
body: I was billed twice for my subscription on the 3rd. Both charges hit my card ending 1111 (4111 1111 1111 1111). Please refund one today, my account is overdrawn.

subject: Question about invoice format
body: Could you add our VAT number to future invoices? It is not urgent, just for our records.

subject: Refund for unused seats
body: We removed five seats from our plan last week but the invoice still shows the old amount. Can you correct it before the next cycle?

subject: Card declined but money taken
body: My payment failed in the app yet my bank shows the charge from 4242 4242 4242 4242. Contact me at maria.test@example.com if you need details.

subject: Annual plan discount?
body: Do you offer a discount if we switch from monthly to annual billing? Just curious about pricing.

subject: Need receipt for expense report
body: Please send a PDF receipt for last month's payment to billing.team@example.org. I need it by the end of the week.

subject: Wrong currency on invoice
body: My invoice was issued in USD but our contract says EUR. Please reissue it in the right currency.

subject: Unauthorized charge on my account
body: There is a charge of $499 I never approved. If this is not reversed I will dispute it with my bank. Call me on +1 555 010 2231.

subject: App crashes on login
body: Since the update the mobile app crashes immediately after I tap Sign in. I cannot access anything and my team is blocked.

subject: Export to CSV drops last row
body: When I export a report to CSV the final row is always missing. I checked three different reports and it happens every time.

subject: Typo on settings page
body: The word 'notifcations' is misspelled on the settings page. Minor, but thought you would want to know.

subject: Data not saving, lost an hour of work
body: Every time I click Save the page shows a spinner and then my edits disappear. I lost an hour of work today.

subject: Dark mode text unreadable
body: In dark mode the table headers are dark grey on black and hard to read. Seen on Chrome and Firefox.

subject: Tooltip flickers on hover
body: The help tooltip next to the search box flickers a bit when I hover over it. It does not stop me from working.

subject: API returns 500 for all requests
body: Our integration has been getting HTTP 500 from your API for the last 30 minutes. Production traffic is failing. Reach me at +1 555 010 7788.

subject: Notifications arrive twice
body: I receive every email notification twice since yesterday. Please look into it when you can.

subject: Add keyboard shortcuts
body: It would be nice to have keyboard shortcuts for common actions like creating a new item. No rush.

subject: Support for single sign-on
body: Our company needs SAML SSO to adopt your product across the team. Is this on the roadmap?

subject: Custom colors for labels
body: Could labels support custom colors instead of the fixed palette? It would make our boards easier to scan.

subject: Bulk edit for tickets
body: We often need to change the status of dozens of items at once. A bulk edit option would save us a lot of time.

subject: Mobile widget
body: A home screen widget showing today's tasks would be great. Thanks for the lovely product!

subject: Webhook for status changes
body: We would like a webhook that fires when an item changes status so we can sync it with our own system.

subject: Export to PDF
body: Please consider adding a PDF export option for reports. Currently we screenshot them.

subject: Audit log needed for compliance
body: Our auditors require an audit log of admin actions before our renewal at the end of this month. Without it we may have to leave.

subject: Locked out of my account
body: I entered the wrong password too many times and now I am locked out. I have a deadline in an hour. My email is jordan.lee@example.com.

subject: Change email address
body: I changed jobs and need to move my account from old.address@example.org to new.address@example.org. How do I do that?

subject: How do I update my display name?
body: I would like to change my display name to include my middle initial. Where is that setting?

subject: Two-factor code not arriving
body: The SMS code for two-factor login never arrives. I tried three times. My number is (555) 010-4417.

subject: Account hacked
body: Someone changed my password and I received a login alert from a country I have never visited. Please secure my account immediately.

subject: Delete my account
body: I am no longer using the service and would like my account and data deleted when convenient.

subject: Add a teammate to our workspace
body: I am the admin and need to invite a new colleague but the invite button is greyed out. Can you help?

subject: Merge duplicate accounts
body: I accidentally created two accounts with different emails. Can they be merged into one?

subject: Thank you!
body: Just wanted to say your support team was great last week. Keep up the good work!

subject: Do you have an office in Berlin?
body: We will be traveling to Berlin in spring and wondered if you have an office we could visit.

subject: Special offer just for you
body: Click here to win a free prize! Limited time only, act now and claim your reward.

subject: Partnership inquiry
body: I run a small consultancy and would like to discuss a reseller partnership. Please forward this to the right person.

subject: Press contact
body: I am a journalist writing about workplace tools. Who should I speak to for a short comment?

subject: Where can I find your security whitepaper?
body: Our procurement team asked for your security whitepaper and certifications. Could you point me to them?

subject: Partner program
body: Do you have a partner program for agencies? I could not find a page about it on your website.

subject: Wrong number
body: I got a message from this address about something I did not sign up for. I think it was sent to me by mistake.
